text:
neel: FYI seeing a smoldering remap + SMART wobble in ap-south2 affecting GPU attach times. Noticed ~10m ago, started as small IO retries and grew.
tara: which nodes?
neel: hot nodes: gnode-332, gnode-339, gnode-347. dmesg snippet: 
```
[  6543.210987] nvme0n1: remap table resize: entries 1024 -> 8192, meta_sync=EIO
[  6543.211111] nvme0: metadata write failed, errno=-5, retrying
[  6543.215000] block: writeback stall detected, flush_time=1.2s
```
evan: ugh. any recent ops flags or scrub schedule tweaks for ap-south2?
neel: we pushed a scrub cadence increase last week and enabled a short KV compaction burst for benchmarks at 02:00 UTC. likely overlap.
sre-bot: ALERT ap-south2 nvme.remap_growth>700/s for 9 nodes - incident=INC-20260507-0147
tara: quick mitigation options: 1) region-level scrub concurrency -> 1, 2) pause KV compaction for 1h, 3) annotate top-hot nodes to pause scrubs, 4) minimize firmware churn until we rule root cause. Prefer non-intrusive first.
evan: agree. annotate command: `kubectl annotate node gnode-332 warehouse.redwood/scrub-paused=true`  I'll do top 6 nodes.
neel: applying compaction backoff flag now: `kv_compaction.window=60m` for ap-south2.
sre-bot: NOTE ops-flags changed: ap-south2.kv_compaction=backoff_60m
(90s)
tara: patching scrub-controller configmap: `region.ap-south2.concurrency=1` and restarting pods.
(2m)
neel: remap growth dropped ~68%, attach p95 improving from ~12s to ~3.5s. :thumbsup:
evan: cost note: if we pivot active GPU attaches cross-region to us-west for remediation, estimate ~ $1.0k/day in egress + preemptible churn. keep as last resort.
storage-tl: open action items: 1) STORAGE-860 ticket to collect SMART/NVMe namespace telemetry and last firmware roll, 2) RFC for scrub-remap backpressure and compaction interlocks (RFC-2026-storage-remap-guards), 3) add remap-growth circuit-breaker to scrub-controller.
ops-lead: notify Dedicated account owners in ap-south2 about transient attach degradation window. ops on standby.
sre-bot: RESOLVE incident=INC-20260507-0147 when nvme.remap_growth<100/s for 30m and attach p95<3s
tara: keeping annotations & compaction backoff for 90m then running a canary re-enable on gnode-347. if remap bounces, prepare firmware rollback plan but only after full telemetry review.
neel: will paste telemetry into STORAGE-860 and update incident channel. closing thread once 30m stability met. :eyes:
